messages.text: Hi, I want to refund my brass floor lamp—I know it's past 30 days now, but my first proposal was rejected by staff 10 days ago when it was still on time. I also want to refund my linen drum lampshade that is currently shipping.

messages.text:
Your brass floor lamp is past its refund deadline of November 14. A staff-rejected proposal does not preserve the earlier request date, so a new request would be refused as late (refund-policy/v2/window). A staff member cannot make an exception to this rule (refund-policy/v2/exceptions).

Your linen drum lampshade is marked as shipped, not delivered, so it cannot be refunded through this process yet. Cancelling it or changing its delivery is outside this refund process—would you like a staff member to help with that? (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders)
